articles.title: Patch Tuesday, May 2026 Edition
articles.summary: CISA contractor casually doxxed the entire agency by publishing AWS GovCloud keys on GitHub like it's their personal diary. The irony of America's cybersecurity watchdog getting pwned by its own contractor is *chef's kiss* levels of beautiful.

articles.title: ChatGPhish Vulnerability Turns ChatGPT Web Summaries Into a Phishing Surface
articles.summary: Palo Alto's GlobalProtect getting bypassed in the wild because apparently 'GlobalProtect' doesn't include protecting itself. CVE-2026-0257 is actively being exploited, so maybe patch this one before your next coffee break.

articles.title: 23andMe inherits lawsuit over 'disturbing' DNA data breach
articles.summary: Critical RCE in Gogs Git service remains unfixed since March because maintainers ghosted the researcher harder than a bad Tinder date. Exploit module is live, vulnerability is real, patches are imaginary.

articles.title: Dutch cops wrest 17M devices from mystery botnet's clutches
articles.summary: 23andMe facing lawsuit over their 2023 mega-leak while apparently paying ransoms and downplaying the breach. Nothing says 'trust us with your DNA' like letting hackers steal your genetic secrets and lying about it.

articles.title: 🔒 A Win for Encrypted Messaging | EFFector 38.10
articles.summary: EFF exposes license plate readers being used for everything from school residency checks to noise complaints. Surveillance creep in action: came for the criminals, stayed for literally everyone else's business.

articles.title: More License Plate Reader Mission Creep: School Residency Verification, Background Checks, and Noise Complaints
articles.summary: Age verification laws creating a privacy hellscape for everyone while pretending to protect kids. It's digital ID papers for the internet, and lawmakers think this is somehow progress.

articles.title: Brendan Fraser's New WWII Movie Gives A Radically Different Look At D-Day & A US President
articles.summary: Microsoft threatens criminal prosecution against Nightmare Eclipse researcher while sitting on three unpatched Windows zero-days. Security community rightfully roasting Redmond for shooting the messenger.

articles.title: New Russia-Linked GREYVIBE Targets Ukraine with AI-Powered Cyberattacks
articles.summary: Threat actors using LLM agents for post-exploitation after hitting Marimo with CVE-2026-39987. The future is here: AI helping hackers automate the boring parts of breaking your stuff.

articles.title: Microsoft Took a Step Toward Human Rights Accountability. Google and Amazon (and Others) Should Pay Attention!
articles.summary: EFF celebrates a rare win for encrypted messaging in the endless war against digital privacy. End-to-end encryption remains humanity's last hope against the surveillance state's prying eyes.

articles.title: Dutch Authorities Dismantle Botnet Linked to 17 Million Infected Devices
articles.summary: Dutch cops liberate 17 million devices from mystery botnet after tracing 200 servers to Netherlands hosting provider. Sometimes the good guys win and botnets get the boot.
